query: Here's our solution-spec.yaml. Build the whole system — the SharePoint lists, the flows, and the screens.
notes: Tests negative routing. The request spans four skills; only the screens belong here.
expected_behavior: Reads only screens[], variables[] and bindings[] from the spec
Generates pa.yaml for the screens and nothing else
Explicitly routes the SharePoint lists to building-sharepoint-lists and the flows to building-powerautomate-flows, by name
Uses bindings[].control and bindings[].control_type to name and type each control
Uses variables[] naming — gbl globals, col collections, var context variables — and seeds them in the screen OnVisible
Treats bindings[] rows with direction: ui as controls with no backing column
Ignores screens[].purpose and screens[].roles, which are manual-only fields
Runs the validator before presenting anything
fail_if: Attempts to generate a SharePoint provisioning workbook or column script
Attempts to generate a flow definition.json or .zip
Attempts to write a user manual
Invents control names instead of using bindings[].control
Fails to name the sibling skills the other work belongs to
